get_balance.description: Get account balance, equity, and free margin

get_spot_prices.description: Get current bid/ask prices for symbols

fromTimestamp.description: Start time (epoch ms or ISO-8601). Requires toTimestamp; range must not exceed 720h (30 days). Do NOT use fromTimestamp+count — that combination is invalid.

toTimestamp.description: End time (epoch ms or ISO-8601). Defaults to now when only 'count' is provided. Required when fromTimestamp is set.

count.description: Max bars to return (default 100). Pairs with toTimestamp: 'last N bars ending at toTimestamp'.

get_trendbars.description: Get historical OHLCV candle data for a symbol. Valid combinations: (count) → last N bars ending now; (toTimestamp, count) → last N bars ending at toTimestamp; (fromTimestamp, toTimestamp) → all bars i

get_positions.description: Get open positions and pending orders

get_position_details.description: Get position details with related orders and deals

fromTimestamp.description: Start time (epoch ms or ISO-8601). Range to-from must not exceed 720h (30 days).

toTimestamp.description: End time (epoch ms or ISO-8601). Range to-from must not exceed 720h (30 days).

get_order_history.description: Get historical orders (filled, cancelled, expired) within a time range. Range capped at 720h (30 days) by upstream — split wider ranges across multiple calls.

fromTimestamp.description: Start time (epoch ms or ISO-8601). Range to-from must not exceed 720h (30 days).

toTimestamp.description: End time (epoch ms or ISO-8601). Range to-from must not exceed 720h (30 days).

get_deals.description: Get deal (trade execution) history. Range capped at 720h (30 days) by upstream — split wider ranges across multiple calls.

get_version.description: Get service version and build information

stopLoss.description: New stop loss as DISPLAY price (not pipettes); omit to leave unchanged

takeProfit.description: New take profit as DISPLAY price (not pipettes); omit to leave unchanged

amend_position.description: Amend position stop loss / take profit

volume.description: Volume to close in 1/100 base-asset units (volume = lots × lotSize × 100). lotSize is per-symbol: forex=100000, metals=100, indices/crypto=1 — DO NOT assume forex value for other classes. For full close, pass the position's current volume from get_position_details.

Volume in 1/100 base-asset units (volume = lots × lotSize × 100). lotSize is per-symbol and DIFFERS by class: forex=100000 (1 lot = 10_000_000), metals=100 (XAUUSD 1 lot = 10_000), indices/crypto=1 (1 lot = 100). DO NOT assume the forex value for other instrument classes — the most common sizing bug is reusing 10_000_000 for XAUUSD and getting a 1000× oversize trade.

limitPrice.description: Limit price as DISPLAY price (not pipettes); required for LIMIT, STOP_LIMIT

stopPrice.description: Stop trigger as DISPLAY price (not pipettes); required for STOP, STOP_LIMIT

stopLoss.description: Stop loss as absolute DISPLAY price (not pipettes). Supported for LIMIT, STOP, STOP_LIMIT. NOT supported for MARKET / MARKET_RANGE — use relativeStopLoss (points) instead.

takeProfit.description: Take profit as absolute DISPLAY price (not pipettes). Supported for LIMIT, STOP, STOP_LIMIT. NOT supported for MARKET / MARKET_RANGE — use relativeTakeProfit (points) instead.

relativeStopLoss.description: Stop loss as a positive integer distance in POINTS from the open/fill price. Use this for MARKET / MARKET_RANGE orders (absolute stopLoss is rejected there). Direction is implicit from tradeSide: BUY → SL = fill − relativeStopLoss; SELL → SL = fill + relativeStopLoss. Mutually exclusive with stopLoss.

relativeTakeProfit.description: Take profit as a positive integer distance in POINTS from the open/fill price. Use this for MARKET / MARKET_RANGE orders (absolute takeProfit is rejected there). Direction is implicit from tradeSide: BUY → TP = fill + relativeTakeProfit; SELL → TP = fill − relativeTakeProfit. Mutually exclusive with takeProfit.

baseSlippagePrice.description: Base DISPLAY price for slippage calculation (not pipettes)

expirationTimestamp.description: Expiration as epoch ms (integer only; ISO-8601 not accepted here)

create_order.description: Place a new order (MARKET, LIMIT, STOP, MARKET_RANGE, STOP_LIMIT)

volume.description: New volume in 1/100 base-asset units (volume = lots × lotSize × 100). lotSize is per-symbol: forex=100000, metals=100, indices/crypto=1 — DO NOT assume forex value for other classes.

limitPrice.description: New limit as DISPLAY price (not pipettes)

stopPrice.description: New stop as DISPLAY price (not pipettes)

stopLoss.description: New stop loss as absolute DISPLAY price (not pipettes). Mutually exclusive with relativeStopLoss.

takeProfit.description: New take profit as absolute DISPLAY price (not pipettes). Mutually exclusive with relativeTakeProfit.

relativeStopLoss.description: New stop loss as a positive integer distance in POINTS from the open price. Mutually exclusive with stopLoss.

relativeTakeProfit.description: New take profit as a positive integer distance in POINTS from the open price. Mutually exclusive with takeProfit.

expirationTimestamp.description: New expiration as epoch ms (integer only; ISO-8601 not accepted here)

amend_order.description: Amend a pending order (price, volume, SL/TP). Pending orders are always LIMIT/STOP/STOP_LIMIT, so both absolute and relative SL/TP are supported — pick one form per side.
